text.c02: [softly] Sorry, calling this late. Did I wake you?
text.c03a: [relieved] Good. [softly] …I just wanted to hear your voice.
text.c03b: [laughs softly] Haha, sorry. [softly] …I just really wanted to hear your voice.
text.c04: [warmly] Did you watch the show tonight?
text.c05a: [surprised] Wait, cool? …I see. [shy] That's kind of embarrassing.
text.c05b: [happy] I knew it! I felt our eyes meet during the encore.
text.c06: [softly] I'm walking home now. It's freezing out here…
text.c07: [curious] Hey, look out your window. Is it snowing?
text.c08: [warmly] See? We're watching the same snow.
text.c09: [softly] …But it's cold. Close the window, or you'll catch a cold.
text.c10: [softly] …Hey. Listen with your other ear too.
text.c12: [whispers] What I'm about to say is a secret, okay?
text.c13: [whispers] From the stage, I kept looking for you. …Only you.
text.c17: [softly] …Did you hear that? Go open the door.
text.c19: [out of breath] I ran here through the snow. [softly] …I'm freezing, so warm me up?
